name: Establish the first Craft Product Feature inside its Product context
outcome: Establish one owner-reviewable System Construction Product Feature thesis contextualized by the Craft Product while preserving Product, Project, Method, Goal, Product Feature, and Product Capability as separate identities.
rationale: Selecting Craft as the new name of the DomainSpec v2 Product lineage does not itself move source, implementation, consumers, or authority; explicit identity and evidence boundaries must precede those effects.
success_conditions: Craft Product, Project, Method, Goal, lineage, and relations have distinct canonical identities
Every identity-graph endpoint resolves and every relation has a valid directional signature
The same-Product rename lineage is explicit and does not infer migration completion
Product Feature selection and implementation remain separately governed
evidence_requirements: Collect-all validation receipts for every CML-07 identity carrier
Separate schema conformance and identity-contract conformance assessment
Negative evidence rejecting identity collapse and Bounded Context inference
Exact source, owner, Artifact Type, and lineage bindings
claim_ceiling: Candidate Goal identity only. Validation or conformance does not establish Goal achievement, Product Feature admission, migration completion, implementation authority, publication, or deployment.
